summary: The risk-engine endpoints behind the Risk Lab. `GET /risk/rules` publishes the rulebook (signals, weights, ATT&CK mappings, levels and thresholds) and `POST /risk/evaluate` scores a hand-picked set of signals without storing anything. Both call the pure functions in `iip/rules.py`, the same code the ingestion pipeline uses, so what-if results always match real scoring.

notes.text: Module docstring: the rulebook and the what-if scorer behind the Risk Lab page.
Postpones evaluation of type hints (they are kept as strings); FastAPI still resolves them when it inspects each endpoint's signature.
`EvaluateIn` validates the list of signal names.
Needs no database: returns `rules.rulebook()`, everything a client needs to render the rules.
Registers `POST /api/v1/risk/evaluate`. It is a POST because it takes a body, but it changes nothing, which is why it carries no `WRITE` dependencies.
`EvaluateIn` rejects unknown signal names with a 422; `rules.what_if` scores the chosen signals exactly as the pipeline would and returns the assessment.
